earliestResponsibleBranch.branch: the ALLCAPS_CAPTION_RE arm of the caption test (noInternalTerminator && (ALLCAPS || numbered))
earliestResponsibleBranch.trace: segmentSourceUnits splits at line breaks, so the waiver is its own unit -> the extractor finds no values -> no inventory span covers it -> classifyUnaccountedFragment runs -> pagination, citation, quoted-label and structural-noise rules all decline -> the ALL-CAPS arm fires and returns HEADING_OR_LABEL. It is the first branch to grant an accounted disposition.

rootCause: ALLCAPS_CAPTION_RE was /^\s*[A-Z][A-Z0-9\s,'&/.-]{2,80}\s*$/. Capitalisation plus a length ceiling WAS the rule; nothing examined what the text asserted. The red team measured the boundary exactly - all caps up to 82 characters was a heading, 84 characters was not - so length was literally the trust boundary. All caps is the standard drafting register for jury-trial waivers, warranty disclaimers and liability caps, so the register that marks the most aggressively enforceable terms in an agreement was the register that made them invisible.

theOrthographicTrap.whatWasTested: Before writing the fix, isNominalLabel (the canary #5/#7 positive label test) was run against all five fixtures.
theOrthographicTrap.conclusion: isNominalLabel separates a name from a proposition by finding a LOWERCASE content word acting as the predicate. Uppercasing destroys that signal: every word in all caps satisfies the proper-noun form, so the function returns true for headings and propositions alike. Delegating the ALL-CAPS frame to it, as §4 invites, would have declared every all-caps line a name - the exact failure this canary exists to prevent. §4 was therefore investigated and rejected on measured evidence, and a conservative case-independent rule was chosen instead per §11.

genericRuleImplemented.invariant: TYPOGRAPHY DOES NOT PROVE HEADING-HOOD. ALL CAPS alone cannot grant an accounted disposition; unknown stays UNACCOUNTED_SOURCE.
genericRuleImplemented.frameDoesNotDecide: ALLCAPS_CAPTION_RE became ALLCAPS_FRAME_RE - it only recognises the typographic frame and grants nothing, exactly as canary #5 did to quotation marks and canary #7 to section numbers. The two caption arms are now separate branches, each with its own positive test and its own reason string.
genericRuleImplemented.positiveTest: isAllCapsNominalHeading: no clause punctuation (. ; : ! ? ,), at least one word, and NO DETERMINER OR PRONOUN anywhere in the run.
genericRuleImplemented.whyDeterminers: What survives uppercasing is grammatical structure. A heading is a bare nominal - a title - and titles in drafting are determinerless ('NEGATIVE COVENANTS', 'EVENTS OF DEFAULT'). A proposition needs arguments, and an argument is introduced by a determiner or is a pronoun. A determiner inside an all-caps run is therefore positive evidence that the run predicates something, and its absence is the only structural evidence of title-hood that casing leaves intact.
genericRuleImplemented.notNewVocabulary: DETERMINERS is a partition of words already present in FUNCTION_WORDS. Nothing in it is a verb, a modal, or specific to any subject matter. No list of SHALL / MAY / MUST / WILL / PAY / DELIVER / MAINTAIN / WAIVE exists anywhere in the implementation, and the fix was never allowed to lowercase-and-match.
genericRuleImplemented.lengthCeilingRemoved: the {2,80} bound is gone. Two permanent assertions hold the line in both directions: a SHORT all-caps proposition ('THE FEE IS WAIVED') surfaces, and a LONG all-caps nominal (109 characters) is still suppressed.
genericRuleImplemented.hardcodedStrings: none - NEGATIVE COVENANTS, RESTRICTED PAYMENTS and EVENTS OF DEFAULT pass because they are determinerless nominals, not because they are named anywhere.

disclosedLimitation.statement: A determinerless all-caps predication - 'BORROWER SHALL PAY INTEREST' - still passes as a heading.
disclosedLimitation.why: The determiner test marks an argument position; it is not a parser, and it is honestly weaker than the mixed-case test. The alternative that would close it is a modal or verb list, which §5 and the trust-boundary architecture forbid.
disclosedLimitation.handling: Recorded rather than papered over, and pinned by a permanent test so it cannot drift unnoticed. It defeats every fixture in the red team's finding 1, and it is not claimed to close the ALL-CAPS layer completely.

valuesRemainHardBlockers.unchanged: The whole suppression block is still gated on values.length === 0, so a fragment carrying a recognised quantitative value can never receive HEADING_OR_LABEL. Untouched.
